Runs the whole analysis from the raw data in `data/raw/`. Each chunk sources one script in `code/`. Run the chunks in order from a fresh session.

```{r}
#| label: load-lib

source(here::here("code", "00_load-lib.R"))
```

# Radiocarbon dates

```{r}
#| label: calibrate-dates

source(here::here("code", "01_calibrate-dates.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: charcoal-stratigraphy

source(here::here("code", "02_charcoal-stratigraphy.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: summed-probability

source(here::here("code", "03_summed-probability.R"))
```

# Soil carbon

```{r}
#| label: carbon-stocks

source(here::here("code", "04_carbon-stocks.R"))
```
